D168.certifications_note: No genuine, recognized vendor/industry professional certification exists for esports or the creator economy. What exists is (a) regionally accredited UNIVERSITY certificates in esports management (academic, not portable pro certs) and (b) platform-branded MOOC completions (e.g. HP Gaming Garage on edX, UC Irvine on Coursera) — training completions, not certifications. No publisher/league/federation issues a standardized professional credential, so this domain is honestly returned empty.
